## eachDayOfInterval

`export default function eachDayOfInterval(dirtyInterval, options)`

Returns an array of Date objects, one for each day within the given interval. `dirtyInterval` supplies the start and end boundaries; `options` adjusts behavior. An interval spanning 6–9 October 2014 yields days 06, 07, 08 and 09, each at 00 hours.

export default function eachDayOfInterval(dirtyInterval, options)

Returns an array of Date objects representing each day within the supplied interval, including the interval's start and end days, ordered from the start. Takes two parameters: dirtyInterval, the interval to expand, and options, an object of additional settings.

@example  // Each day between 6 October 2014 and 10 October 2014:  var result = eachDayOfInterval({    start: new Date(2014, 9, 6),    end: new Date(2014, 9, 10)  })  //=> [  //   Mon Oct 06 2014 00:00:00,  //   Tue Oct 07 2014 00:00:00,  //   Wed Oct 08 2014 00:00:00,  //   Thu Oct 09 2014 00:00:00,  //   Fri Oct 10 2014 00:00:00  // ]
